programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: Directed by Chang cheh, this kung fu film is one of the final efforts in the 'Venoms'' genre. It features a main character who is mistaken for a clan leader.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Take a vacation with sexy Lily Ho and Jimmy Lin Chong on a whirlwind tour of Southeast Asia in one of Shaw Brothers most lively 1960's musical romances.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: This wuxia film's swordsman hero must go against many treacherous warriors to solve the murder of three clan heads.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: After an inn-keeper's daughter witnesses a perverted rape, her true love must rescue her from the greater danger that threatens.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Share the exploits of two con men vying for a horde of hidden gold. In addition to the mix is a Shaolin monk and his dangerous mute sister!

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: In this mind-blowing sequel to the Shaw Brothers' horror hit, zombies run amok, driving doctors to seek a natural cause while the actual one may be supernatural.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Follow a virtuous viper as it sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a dangerous lady in this thriller!

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: In this classic, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu take on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh, making this a 4-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: A brother and sister use the mythical yin/yang Holy Flame kung-fu technique when they seek vengeance for their dead parents.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Watch as rival kung-fu schools try to sabotage Fei-hung's superior Pao Chih Lin clinic until the chivalrous philanthropist shows them the error of their ways.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: A beauty is accused of slaying her boyfriends. After fleeing to Lantau Island, she seduces another man there.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this unofficial third sequel to The 36th Chamber of Shaolin, San Te (Gordon Liu) is given the task of training Fong Sai Yuk.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Two master jewel thieves are set on the same target, but sparks fly between them when they first meet and they fall instantly in love, not knowing that they are rivals.

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandit's son.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt official's obsessive bid to find a hidden treasure leads him to jail and torture his daughter's lover, and bury her alive!

programme.title: The Lark

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung woos a famous courtesan, indulges in some gambling and helps out earthquake victims while incognito in Suzhou.

programme.title: Twin Blades of Doom

programme.title: The 82 Tenants

programme.title: The Lady Assassin

programme.title: Double Bliss

programme.title: The Black Lizard

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung

programme.title: 7-Man Army

programme.title: The Delinquent

programme.title: Godfather of Canton

programme.title: Middle East Street Food Eats
programme.desc: Stephanie highlights the diversity of Middle Eastern cuisine through the lens of street food. Cooking Pakistani kebabs with home chef, Izza Khan, and then learning the complexity of Israeli street food at Dr. Sandwich.

programme.title: Stephanie and the Pitmaster
programme.desc: Stephanie joins UPS driver and home chef, Fernando Carrillo, for a backyard BBQ and a trip to LA institution Carnitas el Momo to learn the subtle art of slow cooking and the techniques of flavor.

programme.title: Legacies and Thai Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie cooks Thai and Peruvian dishes with home chef Brittaney Bunjong and swaps stories about growing up in the kitchen with their moms. Rediscovering the joys and influence of those flavors on her own cooking.

programme.title: Key Ingredients of West African Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie meets Nigerian chefs, Eros and JP, to learn the basics of cooking West African cuisine. From palm oil to locust beans to asaro; Stephanie tests her knowledge and her skills - using these unfamiliar ingredients.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Mother’s Day has a special place in Chef Derrell’s life; he shares his favorite family meal of shrimp with grits, cheddar biscuits and stories from past celebrations. Solo meals include grit cakes, shrimp ceviche and a breakfast biscuit sandwich.

programme.title: Sunday Supper
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is serving up Sunday Supper with his signature meatballs with creamy polenta, parmesan crisps and a spicy gremolata for the family meal. Solo meals are full of flavor with a meatball soup and a delicious meatball mozzarella sub.

programme.title: Ultimate Taco Tuesday
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is doing Taco Tuesday his own delicious way with pernil tacos, mexican street corn and homemade guacamole. The fiesta continues with solo meals of pork empanadas and dessert for dinner with flambe maduros with vanilla ice cream.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Frankie prepares a Valentine’s Day dinner for under $15. Why go to a crowded restaurant for an overpriced prix-fixe menu when you can prep a simple yet decadent romantic meal at home? It’ll be sweet, it’ll be aphrodisiacal, and it’ll be sexy cheap.

programme.title: 5-Ingredient Recipes
programme.desc: Who said struggle meals can’t be delicious? Don’t sleep on these 5-ingredient recipes – simple weeknight meals that are anything but boring, and with a few pantry staples, you’ll have dinner on the table in no time.

programme.title: Pearls in Palawan
programme.desc: Erwan travels to the gorgeous island of Palawan where he meets with the locals and learns about pearl farming.

programme.title: Octopus in Isabela
programme.desc: In this episode, Erwan travels to the remote area of Palanan in Isabela, where he meets the Dumagat tribe and learns how to catch an octopus the traditional way.

programme.title: Mud Crab in Dumaguete
programme.desc: Erwan learned how to catch crustaceans while growing up, but in Dumaguete, he discovers their unique regional approach to catching mud crabs.

programme.title: Rainbow Runner in Apo Island
programme.desc: Apo Island is famous for its marine Sanctuary. Erwan meets environmentalists and learns about the Rainbow Runner fish.

programme.title: Fruit Bat in Mindoro
programme.desc: On the island of Mindoro, Erwan samples a traditional Filipino Adobo, made with an unlikely source of protein - locally caught fruit bats.

programme.title: Flying Fish in Batanes
programme.desc: Batanes, known for its breathtaking coastline, is home to the mataw fishermen clan. With their guidance, Erwan sets out to catch dorado by using flying fish as bait.

programme.title: Summer Fun
programme.desc: As summer heats up, the creators sweat it out in the kitchen putting an original spin on corn ribs and a transforming watermelon into a savory dish. Who will whip up this year’s hottest recipe?

programme.title: Make It or Bake It
programme.desc: Baking videos send our social media feeds in a frenzy and we can’t seem to get enough. Watch as creators impress the judges with a show stopping focaccia, then pay tribute to the mini pancake cereal trend by concocting their own unique cereal.

programme.title: Extra-delicious
programme.desc: They say go big or don’t go at all. When it comes to some viral recipes, going all out is the method to internet madness. Creators customize a burrito made of homemade cotton candy, then shoot for the moon in an over the top nacho spread.

programme.title: Dish in Disguise
programme.desc: The internet falls fast for snacks and hacks that look like one thing but taste like another. Creators must make "donuts" with anything but traditional batter, then flip the script on ramen, using it in an unconventional yet recognizable way.

programme.title: Vegetarian Comfort Food
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith might be a master of meatballs, but in this episode, he shows us that vegetarian food can be down-right soul satisfying. The menu features Kale Pesto Mac & Cheese, Sweet Potato Jamaican Patties with Salsa Verde and Banana Pudding.

programme.title: Sunday Salmon Easter Brunch
programme.desc: Chef Daisy Ryan, an expert in French cooking and cocktails, is cooking up an elegant and easy menu: Salmon Confit, Alsatian Potato Salad and Bernaise Sauce, Lettuces with Mustard Vinaigrette and a fantastic Meyer Lemon Gin Fizz to round things out.

programme.title: Michigan Coney Dogs and Ohio State Po' Boys
programme.desc: We're in Ann Arbor, Michigan where Chef Frank Fejeran is taking us on a trip to a beautiful Buddhist farm and making his local take on the classic Michigan Coney Dog.

programme.title: South Carolina Beef Ribs and Florida Fried Chicken
programme.desc: Boiled peanuts and beef ribs at a South Carolina tailgate; an early morning shrimping trip on the Florida Gulf.

programme.title: Florida State Pork Loin and Tennessee Stuffed Quail
programme.desc: Chef Tom Gray makes a delicious FSU-inspired tailgate dish; the world's best bacon in Tennessee.

programme.title: It’s Floofy and Everything’s Fine
programme.desc: Meghan designs decadently delicious cream puffs and cookies to serve for any occasion and shows the viewer at home the sweet tips and tricks behind the sweet treats.

programme.title: The Opposite of a Hot Mess
programme.desc: Meghan takes your fears about layer cakes and chocolate and throws them out the window. She offers up insider know how and can do-ness to craft up the perfect treats.

programme.title: Take The Time To Do It Right
programme.desc: No one said making pie or a macaroon was easy, but Meghan shows you how to do so with a lot less mess and a lot less stress. She takes the time to share her creative take on these classic confections.

programme.title: Bundt and Roll With It
programme.desc: Get fancy AF in the kitchen by taking your baking skills to 100. It’s all about making your bundt cake bounce and high rolling with your roll cake.

programme.title: Hawaii Spamfest
programme.desc: Hawaii and Spam go together like,...well, they just do, and Amy Shuster is in Honolulu to try its many inceptions at the 14th annual Waikiki Spam Jam.

programme.title: New Orleans French Quarter Festival
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Amy is at the French Quarter Festival taking in a little jazz and a lot of Cajun fare.

programme.title: Combo Meal!
programme.desc: This week, Amy hits the road for the Indio International Tamales Festival. But wait, there's more! We check out Texas Crab in Crystal Beach and then load up on guac and all things avo at Fallbrook's annual Avocado Fest.

programme.title: Sweet Tears of Joy
programme.desc: Watch these together.. but maybe don't try to eat them. This week, Amy Shuster is at the Warkworth Maple Syrup Festival and then heads to Zibelemärit — The Onion Market & Festival in Bern, Switzerland. It's so great you'll cry!

programme.title: German Christmas Market
programme.desc: Discover a true Christmas wonderland as Amy Shuster visits Germany's Christkindlmarkt, a Christmas festival dating back to the 16th century.

programme.title: Wasabi & Strawberry Cheesecake
programme.desc: Tastemaker Emmy Cho travels to Shizuoka and Yokohama to discover the secrets of Kit Kat's Wasabi and Strawberry Cheesecake flavors.

programme.title: Matcha & Ogura Toast
programme.desc: Outside Kyoto, Emmy learns the intricacies and traditions of making matcha, and visits a 600-year-old tea farm. Later, Emmy takes in the cafe culture of Nagoya through Ogura toast and a handful of local specialties.

programme.title: Shichimi 7 Spice Blend & Rum Raisin
programme.desc: In Nagano, Emmy heads to a shichimi pepper farm and a 300-year-old spice shop to learn the history of the 7 spice blend. Later, Emmy tries Tokyo's popular treats to find out how rum raisin gained such prominence in the area.

programme.title: Oceanside in Okinawa
programme.desc: Ocean breeze, turquoise waters and a whole lot of amazing cuisine. Marko and Alex are soaking up that island life in Okinawa, Japan and learning what makes it so unique.

programme.title: The L.A. Lifestyle
programme.desc: Green juice, avocado toast, and surfers galore. Marko and Alex are back home in Los Angeles to explore their town, staycation style. From downtown to the beach, the guys do everything fun under the sun in the city of angels.

programme.title: Cooking off the Land on Orcas Island
programme.desc: We visit Orcas Island to meet Jay Blackinton, a farmer & chef who is redefining farm-to-table for his customers. His menu changes daily and is made exclusively with what he and his team have grown on the island.

programme.title: Molecular Gastronomy in San Diego

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Suatu hari, cucunya Rin, telah menggodam satu permainan komputer dan dia dihubungi oleh seorang misteri dalam talian yang mengetahui identiti Rin. Roz mengesyaki sesuatu tidak kena, tapi malangnya Rin telah diculik oleh penjahat misteri tersebut sebelum Roz sempat bertindak.

programme.title: #Tom Tom Bak Series Ep3
programme.desc: Datuk Aznil Haji Nawawi turun padang sempena pencarian bakat baru #TomTomBak. Ramai yang hadir untuk menonjolkan bakat yang mereka ada. Bermacam ragam & aksi lucu dapat kita saksikan. Anak-anak yang petah berborak juga turut dicari untuk musim terbaru ini.

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Geng menemui bakat terpendam Eu Jin, iaitu menyanyi! Mereka semua berusaha untuk membuat lagu baru yang hebat dengan merakam audio dan muzik dengan pengkodan mereka sendiri, tetapi tanpa mengendahkan keinginan Eu Jin - yang akhirnya merasakan dirinya dipergunakan oleh geng.

programme.title: Oh My English! S1 Ep9
programme.desc: Di SMK Ayer Dalam, ‘Kelas 3 Merah' terkenal sebagai kelas yang mempunyai berbagai kerenah. Pelajar-pelajarnya nakal, suka buat bising. Subjek yang mereka paling tidak gemar ialah Bahasa Inggeris.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep8
programme.desc: Ep08 Daniel menyesaki ibunya menyembunyikan sesuatu. Roz pula menyelinap masuk pengkalan operasi Gagak Putih dan telah diserang. Roz berdepan dengan kesilapan masa silamnya sebagai seorang ibu, isteri dan ejen perisik, yang kini kembali untuk memusnahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Suatu hari, cucunya Rin, telah menggodam satu permainan komputer dan dia dihubungi oleh seorang misteri dalam talian yang mengetahui identiti Rin. Roz mengesyaki sesuatu tidak kena, tapi malangnya Rin telah diculik oleh penjahat misteri tersebut sebelum Roz sempat bertindak.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Ep02 Roz cuba menenangkan Indah yang risaukan Rin dan Daniel yang telah mulakan penyiasatan. Namun Daniel tidak mahu mendengar nasihat ibunya, Roz. Daniel dan Roz menggunakan cara berbeza untuk mencari Rin. Pihak polis menerima rakaman pesanan suara Rin.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ramona meminta bantuan Geng untuk menjadi influencer terkenal, di mana Aly dan geng membantunya membuat filter baru menggunakan kod mereka. Melalui usaha mereka, Ramona mempelajari bagaimana sikap pengguna dalam talian, sekaligus Aly dan geng membantu Ramona menghadapi masalahnya.

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Geng menemui bakat terpendam Eu Jin, iaitu menyanyi! Mereka semua berusaha untuk membuat lagu baru yang hebat dengan merakam audio dan muzik dengan pengkodan mereka sendiri, tetapi tanpa mengendahkan keinginan Eu Jin - yang akhirnya merasakan dirinya dipergunakan oleh geng.

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Perniagaan Kedai Bob semakin merosot dan Geng memutuskan untuk merancang & membina kedai dalam talian yang akhirnya memperoleh kejayaan! Namun, masalah berlaku apabila pemilik kedai pesaing menggoda Hafiz dengan perjanjian yang akan mengkhianati rakan-rakannya.

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Aly dan geng di perkenalkan kepada Ramona, yang memerlukan bantuan mereka untuk merakam video untuknya, yang sebagai gantinya, berjanji akan membuat video promo untuk kedai ayah Aly

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Mesin pencetak kedai Bob tiba-tiba rosak dan perlu diperbaiki. Aly dan geng mesti bergabung bersama untuk memperbaikinya untuk pelanggan. Namun, Nabil dan Eu Jin tidak hadir kerana mereka obses terhadap "Akses Premium" untuk permainan yang mereka mainkan.

programme.title: Oh My English! S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Di SMK Ayer Dalam, ‘Kelas 3 Merah' terkenal sebagai kelas yang mempunyai berbagai kerenah. Pelajar-pelajarnya nakal, suka buat bising. Subjek yang mereka paling tidak gemar ialah Bahasa Inggeris.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep8
programme.desc: Ep08 Daniel menyesaki ibunya menyembunyikan sesuatu. Roz pula menyelinap masuk pengkalan operasi Gagak Putih dan telah diserang. Roz berdepan dengan kesilapan masa silamnya sebagai seorang ibu, isteri dan ejen perisik, yang kini kembali untuk memusnahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Suatu hari, cucunya Rin, telah menggodam satu permainan komputer dan dia dihubungi oleh seorang misteri dalam talian yang mengetahui identiti Rin. Roz mengesyaki sesuatu tidak kena, tapi malangnya Rin telah diculik oleh penjahat misteri tersebut sebelum Roz sempat bertindak.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Ep02 Roz cuba menenangkan Indah yang risaukan Rin dan Daniel yang telah mulakan penyiasatan. Namun Daniel tidak mahu mendengar nasihat ibunya, Roz. Daniel dan Roz menggunakan cara berbeza untuk mencari Rin. Pihak polis menerima rakaman pesanan suara Rin.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E10 - Reca
programme.desc: Sumérgete en la temporada de Dropped mientras los hermanos recapitulan una épica aventura de 30 días a través de la sabana canadiense.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E01 - Back In The Brooks
programme.desc: 經過幾年的努力，Keefer兄弟終於回到阿拉斯加的荒野，探索碎石路。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E02 - Maniac Mountain
programme.desc: 十多年之後，狂人山為兄弟們帶來了另一個開創性的成就。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E03 - Arctic Apex
programme.desc: Keefer兄弟陷入灰熊與狼之間的對決，挑戰誰才是真正食品鏈的頂端。

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: Cuando los seres humanos son un grave peligro para sí mismos ... Horas desesperadas analiza catástrofes nucleares e industriales como el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima en Japón, el de la central nuclear de Chernóbil en Ucrania, el vertido de petróleo en aguas profundas del Golfo de México, el del Savar Plaza en Bangladesh y el del gas de Bhopal en la India. Cuando se produce una catástrofe en una central nuclear, el desastre resultante puede ser, literalmente, fuera de escala y durar décadas.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: La navegación es un negocio peligroso, de hecho...... Las horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes ocurridas en alta mar, como el desastre del transbordador Sewol en Corea del Sur, el Ferry Estonia en el mar Báltico, el hundimiento del Titanic, el Exxon Valdez en Prince William Sound Alaska, el Express Samina en Portes Islets, los ataques piratas al Maersk Alabama y al Seabourn Spirit, y el Costa Concordia en el mar Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller...... Los accidentes aéreos son las peores pesadillas de la mayoría de la gente. Horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes de la historia de la aviación, como los vuelos MH17 y MH370 de Malaysia Airlines, el vuelo 447 de Air France, el vuelo 9525 de Germanwings, el desastre del aeropuerto de Tenerife, las catástrofes de los transbordadores espaciales Challenger y Columbia, el accidente del C-130 de la Fuerza Aérea Indonesia en Sumatra en 2015, el accidente del Antonov An-124 de Irkutsk en 1997 y el accidente del vuelo 4590 del Concorde.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters
programme.desc: Abróchese el cinturón y manténgase alerta...... Horas desesperadas analiza los accidentes de tráfico y ferroviarios, entre ellos el accidente ferroviario español de Santiago de Compostela, un accidente de carretera en Pakistán, el accidente de un camión petrolero en Nigeria en el que murieron 96 personas, el accidente ferroviario del Queen of the Sea en Sri Lanka, los accidentes provocados por la niebla en Italia y el Reino Unido, un accidente de cien vehículos en la autopista A1 en Austria, un accidente de carretera en México y un accidente de Amtrak en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Más vale prevenir que curar...... Horas desesperadas analiza el Protocolo de Kioto y el peligro de la subida del nivel del mar. El programa examina las causas de las catástrofes medioambientales, como los vertederos, la gran mancha de basura del Pacífico, los vertidos de petróleo, la contaminación atmosférica y la destrucción de la selva tropical, así como los efectos destructivos de las catástrofes medioambientales, como el agotamiento de la capa de ozono y el aumento de las temperaturas en el Ártico.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E02 - Nightmare Canyon Part 2
programme.desc: Parte 2: El fin de semana de escalada de Justin y Jeremy Harris ha resultado en un serio peligro para los hermanos. Con Justin totalmente incapacitado cuando se rompe la pierna le toca a Jeremy ir solo y tratar de conseguir ayuda. A medida que cae la noche y las temperaturas descienden hasta el punto de congelación, el tiempo es crítico para que los hermanos sobrevivan.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E03 - Under the Desert Sun
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal emprendió una corta caminata en el Parque Nacional Joshua Tree, pero en el calor del día se dio la vuelta y se perdió. Sus seis días de supervivencia a temperaturas abrasadoras, sin comida ni agua, son casi milagrosos.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E04 - Treestand Nightmare
programme.desc: Cuando el Dr. Joe Baumgardner, ávido cazador con arco, se dispone a realizar el mantenimiento rutinario de sus puestos en los árboles, una caída de seis metros le deja con una pierna gravemente rota y a kilómetros de ayuda en los profundos bosques de Mississippi.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E05 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 1
programme.desc: Mientras escalaba en solitario el monte Goddard, una remota cima de la Sierra de California, una roca aplasta la pierna de Gregg Hein, que se precipita montaña abajo. Apenas puede detener la caída y se enfrenta a una terrible fractura.

Horas desesperadas analiza los accidentes de tráfico y ferroviarios, entre ellos el accidente ferroviario español de Santiago de Compostela, un accidente de carretera en Pakistán, el accidente de un camión petrolero en Nigeria en el que murieron 96 personas, el accidente ferroviario del Queen of the Sea en Sri Lanka, los accidentes provocados por la niebla en Italia y el Reino Unido, un accidente de cien vehículos en la autopista A1 en Austria, un accidente de carretera en México y un accidente de Amtrak en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Más vale prevenir que curar...... Horas desesperadas analiza el Protocolo de Kioto y el peligro de la subida del nivel del mar. El programa examina las causas de las catástrofes medioambientales, como los vertederos, la gran mancha de basura del Pacífico, los vertidos de petróleo, la contaminación atmosférica y la destrucción de la selva tropical, así como los efectos destructivos de las catástrofes medioambientales, como el agotamiento de la capa de ozono y el aumento de las temperaturas en el Ártico.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E02 - Nightmare Canyon Part 2
programme.desc: Parte 2: El fin de semana de escalada de Justin y Jeremy Harris ha resultado en un serio peligro para los hermanos. Con Justin totalmente incapacitado cuando se rompe la pierna le toca a Jeremy ir solo y tratar de conseguir ayuda. A medida que cae la noche y las temperaturas descienden hasta el punto de congelación, el tiempo es crítico para que los hermanos sobrevivan.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E03 - Under the Desert Sun
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal emprendió una corta caminata en el Parque Nacional Joshua Tree, pero en el calor del día se dio la vuelta y se perdió. Sus seis días de supervivencia a temperaturas abrasadoras, sin comida ni agua, son casi milagrosos.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E04 - Treestand Nightmare
programme.desc: Cuando el Dr. Joe Baumgardner, ávido cazador con arco, se dispone a realizar el mantenimiento rutinario de sus puestos en los árboles, una caída de seis metros le deja con una pierna gravemente rota y a kilómetros de ayuda en los profundos bosques de Mississippi.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E05 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 1
programme.desc: Mientras escalaba en solitario el monte Goddard, una remota cima de la Sierra de California, una roca aplasta la pierna de Gregg Hein, que se precipita montaña abajo. Apenas puede detener la caída y se enfrenta a una terrible fractura.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E09 - The End
programme.desc: En el emocionante final de temporada, Chris se lo juega todo por última vez mientras caza un oso. Casey debe terminar una última tarea para que el fruto de su trabajo merezca la pena. A medida que los hermanos se acercan a un lugar seguro, se preguntan qué les deparará el futuro.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E10 - Reca
programme.desc: Sumérgete en la temporada de Dropped mientras los hermanos recapitulan una épica aventura de 30 días a través de la sabana canadiense.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E01 - Back In The Brooks
programme.desc: 經過幾年的努力，Keefer兄弟終於回到阿拉斯加的荒野，探索碎石路。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E02 - Maniac Mountain
programme.desc: 十多年之後，狂人山為兄弟們帶來了另一個開創性的成就。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E03 - Arctic Apex
programme.desc: Keefer兄弟陷入灰熊與狼之間的對決，挑戰誰才是真正食品鏈的頂端。

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: Cuando los seres humanos son un grave peligro para sí mismos ... Horas desesperadas analiza catástrofes nucleares e industriales como el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima en Japón, el de la central nuclear de Chernóbil en Ucrania, el vertido de petróleo en aguas profundas del Golfo de México, el del Savar Plaza en Bangladesh y el del gas de Bhopal en la India. Cuando se produce una catástrofe en una central nuclear, el desastre resultante puede ser, literalmente, fuera de escala y durar décadas.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: La navegación es un negocio peligroso, de hecho...... Las horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes ocurridas en alta mar, como el desastre del transbordador Sewol en Corea del Sur, el Ferry Estonia en el mar Báltico, el hundimiento del Titanic, el Exxon Valdez en Prince William Sound Alaska, el Express Samina en Portes Islets, los ataques piratas al Maersk Alabama y al Seabourn Spirit, y el Costa Concordia en el mar Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller...... Los accidentes aéreos son las peores pesadillas de la mayoría de la gente. Horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes de la historia de la aviación, como los vuelos MH17 y MH370 de Malaysia Airlines, el vuelo 447 de Air France, el vuelo 9525 de Germanwings, el desastre del aeropuerto de Tenerife, las catástrofes de los transbordadores espaciales Challenger y Columbia, el accidente del C-130 de la Fuerza Aérea Indonesia en Sumatra en 2015, el accidente del Antonov An-124 de Irkutsk en 1997 y el accidente del vuelo 4590 del Concorde.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
programme.desc: 儘管所有媒體的喧囂，其中許多並不算水準，哈里依然是一個謎。這部引人入勝的紀錄片提供了新視角和鏡頭，來揭示一位面對心痛和丑聞的皇室王子的故事。

programme.desc: Ivan Carter investiga un trágico ataque de cocodrilos en el río Zambeze de África.

programme.desc: Laramy Sasquatch Miller emprende El Camino con su fiel caballo 7, para poner a prueba sus habilidades de supervivencia y rendir homenaje a los hombres de montaña del pasado. programme.desc: 當翡翠發現她母親的財務問題後，她與暗戀對象一同進行一系列高調竊案，以償還母親的債務。

programme.title: Been There All Along
programme.desc: After her public breakup, Charley, determined founder of a dating app, is near bankruptcy and teamed up with Liam, a self-assured and innovative marketing expert, to save her company.

programme.title: Falling for the Competition
programme.desc: Molly runs the local mom's group and this year they're entering the prestigious Modern Parenting Group of the Year Contest. When a new to town dad, Ashley, sets up a rival dad's group, their competitive natures cause competition in town.

programme.title: Conflict of Love Interest
programme.desc: 斯嘉麗以她的約會冒險而聞名，決定幫助她那永遠單身的朋友珍妮在愛情方面取得突破。然而，當她們合作時，斯嘉麗開始對那個可能是珍妮完美伴侶的男孩產生情感。

programme.title: Our Mother's Secret Affair
programme.desc: 黛安娜·帕克發現她家中的入侵者實際上是她的親生女兒，幾年前她將其交給了領養。當他們努力重建彼此的關係時，他們遇到了一個危險的威脅 - 一個無情的殺手，將不惜一切代價阻止他們重聚，即使這意味著謀殺。

programme.title: Pocket Dial Murder
programme.desc: 故事跟隨史黛西，她接到丈夫的誤撥電話。在電話的另一頭，她聽到一名女子的死訊。當她丈夫回家時，他說他的手機不見了。

programme.title: Kidnapped to the Island
programme.desc: 一位渴望成為流行歌手的星粉少女失踪，她關心的單親媽媽出發拯救她，免遭那位引誘她來遙遠小島的控制性歌手的掌控，該歌手以名聲和財富為誘惑。

programme.title: Danger Rocks the Cradle
programme.desc: Nicolette, a high school senior has bounced around from foster home to home. She started feeling hopeless when found herself pregnant by the school quarterback.

programme.title: Love on the Reef
programme.desc: A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before it's too late.

programme.title: The Soulmate Search
programme.desc: When Lindsay gets the chance to sign up to the notoriously exclusive dating service Eternity, she clashes with Will, her first date. They mutually agree this dating service has been a complete bust and make a deal to get their money back.

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby，一位有抱負的浪漫小說作家，為了獲得有利可圖的書籍合約，參加了她的文學英雄和當下最熱門作家Marcus Harlow在塔霍主持的一個寫作研討會。但當戶外型酒店老闆Woody向她展示大自然的美麗時，Ruby開始懷疑自己是否寫了錯誤的故事來打動像Marcus這樣的人。

programme.title: Threats From The Inside
programme.desc: 布拉德·柯林斯對妻子的愛變成了佔有慾，變得越來越控制。當他懷疑她有外遇時，發生了一場導致悲劇的激烈爭吵。

programme.title: The Wedding in the Hamptons
programme.desc: Jenna is a fashion designer who works for her friend's boutique. Their failing business was saved by a famous influencer. When Jenna comes to a lavish Hamptons wedding, she was mistaken for her, but she decides to go along to save business

programme.title: The Marry Me Pact
programme.desc: 夏洛特和羅里是最好的朋友，為了慶祝他30歲生日，羅里去環遊世界。一年後，夏洛特去看了一位算命師，算命師告訴她她的命中註定是當羅里回來時和他在一起。羅里回來了……但他已經訂婚了。

programme.title: Two Chefs and a Wedding Cake
programme.desc: 這是一位處於事業巔峰的美食評論家，遇到一位因拒絕美食評論家而聞名的廚師的故事。在她妹妹的婚禮前，他們必須克服彼此的分歧。

programme.title: Body in the Attic
programme.desc: 一位不滿的妻子說服她的情人住在閣樓。當她發現他的屍體時，她堅信她不知情的丈夫知道這段婚外情，並保持沉默以向她報復。
